entries.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
entries.summary: Lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships and new ThinkYoung research. Supporting teachers, AI literacy and independent learning.

entries.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
entries.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

entries.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

entries.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
entries.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

entries.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
entries.summary: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

entries.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
entries.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

entries.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
entries.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

entries.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
entries.summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

entries.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
entries.summary: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

entries.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
entries.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

entries.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
entries.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

entries.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
entries.summary: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

entries.title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
entries.summary: Flipsnack focused its ChatGPT Ads campaigns on getting people to try its product, growing registrations while lowering the cost per signup.

entries.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
entries.summary: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is developing AI workflows to help portfolio managers compare research views and examine investment risks.

entries.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
entries.summary: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

entries.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
entries.summary: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

entries.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
entries.summary: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

entries.title: Introducing Images 2.6
entries.summary: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

entries.title: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
entries.summary: DevRev uses GPT-6.1 Sol to power Computer and Operator, balancing reasoning, speed, and cost for enterprise service.

entries.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
entries.summary: Discover how ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers accelerate CAD, PCB design, simulation, and other workflows across the physical world.

entries.title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
entries.summary: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.

entries.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
entries.summary: Discover how Heimstaden uses OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to transform property management, cut costs, and empower employees across Europe.

entries.title: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
entries.summary: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.

entries.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
entries.summary: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.

entries.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
entries.summary: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.
